name: Knights College 2
source:
Argo, a young man who had been living a quiet life in a rural fishing village, has entered the Knight Academy to become a knight and successfully advanced to his second year.

The academy, composed of students from the homeland Frontail and international students from neighboring Harshreich, welcomes new students from each country again this year, starting a new season.

Additionally, the dragon Baten from Ludovigo joins as a student, and the knight commander Bayfreed returns from his expedition, bringing even more color to Argo’s academy life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
原本在乡村渔村过着平静生活的青年阿尔戈，进入骑士学院成为骑士，并顺利升入二年级。

这所由来自祖国Frontail的学生和来自邻国Harshreich的国际学生组成的学院今年再次迎来了来自各国的新生，开启了新的学期。

此外，来自卢多维戈的龙巴顿以学生身份加入，骑士指挥官贝弗里德远征归来，为阿尔戈的学园生活增添了更多色彩。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850870/]Steam[/url]]
